candidates.abstract: ATC Williams is seeking a full-time Cadet Civil Drafter in Brisbane to prepare civil drawings and assist with mining and waste projects. Apply now!

candidates.content_text:
CREATE YOUR FUTURE AT ATC WILLIAMS!
About Us:
Renowned for our technical excellence, ATC Williams provides Tailings, Water, and Waste Management services to the mining, resources, and governments sectors. We are a leading specialised engineering and consulting firm with 45 years of successful service to our clients. With eight national office locations and a broad variety of international projects, we offer exciting and sustainable career pathways, whether you are a technical or professional leader, or just starting out in your career.
Why Join Us?
You will be joining our team at an exciting time as ATC Williams continue to solidify our position as a trusted and recognised engineering brand. We are embarking on a significant growth phase, represented by expansion in office locations, employees, opportunities, and capabilities.
About the Role:
We are continually looking for enthusiastic and talented people to join our team.
Our Brisbane, Queensland office is currently seeking a Cadet Civil Drafter on a permanent, full-time basis.
Key Responsibilities and Activities Include:
- Prepare and update civil drawings for waste, water and mining projects under supervision.
- Assist with drawing production using AutoCAD.
- Prepare figures, sketches and plans for reports and proposals.
- Assist with quantity take-offs and bills of quantities.
- Maintain drawings in accordance with ATCW CADD standards and document-control requirements.
- Undertake basic engineering and design-support tasks under supervision.
Knowledge, Experience and Skill Requirements Include:
- Diploma or Associate Degree in Civil Engineering, either recently completed or nearing completion.
- Basic AutoCAD capability, with a willingness to develop proficiency in general civil drafting.
- Good attention to detail and willingness to follow established drafting standards.
- Clear communication skills and the ability to seek guidance.
- Motivation to build a long-term career in civil drafting and design.
- A White Card and current driver’s licence (desired, not essential).
What You Gain when you Join ATC Williams
As an entirely employee-owned organisation with a retention rate to be proud of, our talented and skilled people acknowledge two key reasons why they choose to stay at ATC Williams:
- The depth and generosity of our in-house knowledge and expertise, and
- The fantastic opportunities available for personal growth and diverse project experiences, especially if you are prepared to grab these opportunities with both hands.
Employee Benefits Include:
- Competitive remuneration package.
- Employee-owned company.
- Career and personal development opportunities & mentoring.
- Company paid parental leave.
- Flexible working arrangements available as required.
At ATC Williams, we champion diversity, inclusion, integrity, and equal employment opportunities.
We encourage you to create your future at ATC Williams.
To apply, please provide a cover letter and CV as one attachment to your application and include:
- Rights to work in Australia (essential).
- Base Salary Package expectations.
- Why you have applied for this role.
- Share your career aspirations with us.
Applications close Thursday, 15 October 2026.
Please note ATC Williams does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies.

candidates.title: Cadet - Civil Engineering
candidates.abstract: Gain hands-on civil engineering experience, paid study support and mentoring while helping deliver projects that shape our city.
candidates.location: Shellharbour, Wollongong, Illawarra & South Coast NSW
bullets: Paid cadetship with mentoring and professional support
Exposure to roads, drainage and civil construction
Apply university learning to real community projects
candidates.content_text:
Are you currently studying a Bachelor of Engineering (Civil) and looking to gain real-world engineering experience while you complete your degree?
Launch your engineering career with Shellharbour City Council and develop practical skills, industry knowledge and professional networks through a structured cadetship program designed to support your transition from university to the workplace.
The Civil Engineer Cadetship is a structured training and development opportunity for students who have successfully completed at least four semesters (96 credit points) of a Bachelor of Engineering (Civil) and are about to commence or are currently undertaking their third year of study.
Combining paid practical experience with ongoing study, you'll work alongside experienced engineers and professionals across Engineering, Asset Strategy and our Oak Flats Services Depot, gaining valuable exposure to a broad range of local government engineering functions.
You will have the opportunity to contribute to projects that shape the future of one of NSW's fastest growing cities. 
Gain hands-on experience across areas such as:
 - Road and transport infrastructure
 - Traffic engineering
 - Flood and stormwater management
 - Civil works and construction projects
 - Project delivery and asset planning and management
 This is an opportunity to apply what you're learning at university to real projects that make a difference in the local community.
Through Council's Cadet, Apprentice and Trainee (CAT) Program, you'll receive ongoing mentoring, professional development and on-the-job training while completing your degree. The program is designed to build future talent and support students to develop the technical, professional and leadership skills needed for a successful career.
For more information on our CAT Program, click here.
About us: 
Shellharbour City, located in the Illawarra region, is just 80 minutes south of Sydney and is home to over 86,000 people in a city that spans 154 square kilometres. It's an area of great natural beauty - stretching west from the picturesque coastline to rolling pastures, set against the majestic backdrop of the Illawarra escarpment. 
Our dedication to be financially sustainable in an evolving environment, while striving for a great organisational culture and committing to employing staff who embrace our core values, has made Shellharbour City Council an employer of choice.
We have been recognised with numerous state and national awards in recent times, including eight wins for our First Nations Community the Yirran Muru (many pathways) playspace, as well as being presented as winners in the NSW Landscape Architecture Awards, Regional Achievement Awards, and Parks and Leisure Australia Regional Awards of Excellence.
We offer:
Shellharbour City Council offers a high performing and sustainable organisation to deliver outcomes for the community through leadership, collaboration and innovation. We have exciting, rewarding career opportunities and flexible working arrangements to support a healthy work/life balance. 
 - Temporary full time, 35 hours per week with access to flexi-time 
 - Commencing salary range from $1,116.30 - $1,279.60 per week (based on university progression)
 - Plus 12% superannuation
 - Payment of course fees upon receipt of enrolment record
 - Additional Allowance of $230 per subject for essential student expenses such as administration fees, course materials including textbooks and prescribed readings
 - Study and Examination Leave for face-to-face and online courses
 - Structured Cadetship Program including a Mentor and Peer Program
 - Plus benefits including novated leasing, retail discounts, corporate fitness programs, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) support & Learning & Development opportunities
 - Plus Annual Award Increases & Bi-annual bonus payments & weekly pay run
 - Plus a range of local government benefits, including LSL after 5 years, one week 'My Leave', health & wellbeing initiatives as well as generous parental leave entitlements. 
 For further information about the position, click here for the position description.
Contact: Kristi Barrett, Team Leader Learning and Development on 4221 6236. 
Closing date: Monday, 5 October 2026 at 11:30pm. 
Apply now...
Complete the application below by answering the questions, describing how your skills and experience are relevant to the position. 
Your Resume and qualifications can be attached on the NEXT page.
Once you start your online application, you may save and return to this later, however incomplete applications will not be considered. You may wish to prepare your responses in a word document and then COPY and PASTE into the fields below. Your Resume and qualifications can be attached on the NEXT page.
When you have submitted your application, an email confirmation will be sent to your nominated email address. Please ensure you have the correct email address and check your inbox (including your "junk" inbox). 
For further information about the selection process including tips on how to address the selection criteria, please view our Guide to Applying. 
Shellharbour City Council is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values the unique strengths and talents of all people. Aboriginal Torres Strait Islander people, people from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds and people with a disability are encouraged to apply.
At Shellharbour City Council we promote respect at work as a fundamental right for all and strive to create a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. This commitment extends to the promotion of the rights of all children and young people to be safe from harm when interacting with our services and spaces. Our values, Collaboration, Accountability, Integrity, Respect and Sustainability underpin all we do.
Your decision to apply for a role at Shellharbour City Council is the first step in acknowledging your alignment to our values and aspirations to create a great workplace.

candidates.title: Civil Drafter - Junior to Mid Level
candidates.abstract: Exciting opportunity for a junior/experienced Civil Drafter (AutoCAD 2d) seeking to grow their career in a friendly and supportive consultancy.
bullets: Flexible, friendly and supportive work environment.
Opportunity for professional development and long term career progression.
candidates.content_text:
Why Martens?
Are you looking to become a member of a growing, vibrant and well established multidisciplinary professional engineering consulting firm? Are you searching for opportunities to develop your civil drafting skills and applying these to achieve high quality outcomes?
Martens & Associates, established since 1989, is a well established multidisciplinary professional consulting firm that provides a full range of civil, geotechnical and environmental engineering and town planning services. Our business is built on the quality of our staff and our flexible and friendly work environment. We believe that the skills, capability and enthusiasm of our people give us our competitive advantage.
About The Role
We are seeking a talented junior to intermediate level Civil Drafter (AutoCAD 2d) to become a valued member of our busy multidisciplinary engineering office based in Hornsby, NSW.
The role presents an excellent opportunity for an experienced civil drafter wishing to build on their existing career. It is also suitable for willing and enthusiastic new or recently qualified drafters, engineers, and engineering students wanting to build their experience.
It involves working from our Hornsby office on projects with a wide range of civil engineering works including:
- Property and development drainage assessment.
- Development of site water quality, quantity and drainage solutions.
- Civil engineering design of earthworks, roads, regrading, etc.
- Flood assessments, remediation and management plans.
Competitive salary on offer, negotiable on the basis of experience.
About You
We are seeking candidates that take pride in their work, have a positive attitude, are punctual, reliable, hardworking and able to work in a dynamic and fast paced environment.
It is essential for the applicants to have:
- Good verbal and written communications skills in English.
- The ability to work in a culturally diverse and multi disciplinary team environment.
- Positive and proactive attitude and be motivated, team player, organised and eager to learn.
- Full time Australian work rights (no restricted visa holders).
- Demonstrable high level 2d drafting skills with BricsCAD or AutoCAD.
Shortlisted applicants will be asked to provide copies of past relevant works and/or showcase their drafting skills at the interview.
Any of the following experiences and qualities will be considered favourable:
- Previous drafting experience with large drawing sets (using xref, layer state, annotation scale, paper space, publish, sheet set, etc.), preferably as a civil drafter in land development projects in Australia.
- Familiar with the general process of land development (DA, CC, etc.) and civil engineering design components (site analysis, earthworks, roads, drainage, etc.).
- Experience with GIS software packages (QGIS, ArcGIS, etc.).
- Experience with Lisp coding for AutoCAD and/or Python scripting for QGIS.
How to Apply
If you are interested in this opportunity and meet the above requirements, please apply:
- Preferably, through this post.
- Alternatively, by sending an email to careers@martens.com.au with [CivilDrafter260922] and your full name in the email subject.
Please provide your cover letter, resume, all relevant academic transcripts to date, and contactable work referees, as part of your application.
We encourage direct applications (preferably not via recruiters).
Ramin Kolahdoozha / Soroush Ziaee

Junior Civil Drafter - Global Rail Infrastructure Team

An exciting opportunity has become available for a Junior Civil Drafter to join a globally connected Rail Infrastructure team based in Perth.

You'll gain exposure to major rail and civil infrastructure projects, working alongside experienced specialists delivering projects from concept through to construction across Australia and internationally.
Key Responsibilities
 - Prepare accurate 2D and 3D drawings for rail and civil infrastructure projects.
 - Develop rail alignment plans, longitudinal sections, cross-sections and track layout drawings.
 - Produce drawings for earthworks, drainage, and associated civil infrastructure.
 - Prepare Issued for Construction (IFC) documentation in line with project requirements and industry standards.
 - Manage drawing revisions and incorporate design updates throughout project delivery.
 - Maintain drawing registers and support document control processes.
 - Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure quality and consistency across project deliverables.

 - Certificate or Diploma in Civil Engineering Drafting or equivalent qualification.
 - Proficiency in AutoCAD and/or MicroStation.

 - Ability to interpret engineering drawings, standards and specifications.
 - Strong communication and teamwork skills.
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet project deadlines.
About Airswift
Airswift is an international workforce solutions provider within the energy, process and infrastructure industries. Airswift serves as a strategic partner to our clients, offering a turnkey workforce solution to capture and deliver the top talent needed to complete successful projects by aligning with the unique needs of our clients.
With over 1000 employees and 9,000+ contractors operating in over 130 countries, our geographical reach and pool of talent available is unmatched in the industry and the level of experience, exposure and expertise that the organization has is unparalleled.
Only candidates with the right to work in Australia will be considered. (Australia Citizen, PR Holder, or Valid Australia working VISA)
If you would like to be considered for the position, please apply directly to this advertisement or send your application via email to kashmera.vijayakumaran@airswift.com with your updated CV/ resume & contact details. Alternatively, you may contact Kash at +61 08 6256 0338 for more information.

candidates.content_text:
Kickstart Your Career in Engineering Drafting!
Ready to turn your interest in design and engineering into a career?
Whether you’re finishing Year 12, recently left school or studying Civil Drafting at TAFE, this is your opportunity to get started in the engineering industry.
STP Consultants is looking for an enthusiastic Junior Civil Draftsperson to join our growing Brisbane team. You’ll work alongside experienced civil engineers and drafters, gain hands-on experience and learn how the drawings you create become part of real projects across Queensland.
You don’t need years of experience. We’re looking for someone with the right attitude, curiosity and willingness to learn.
Why you’ll love working here
Start building your career
Get hands-on experience from day one and develop practical civil drafting skills while learning from experienced engineers and drafters.
Work on real projects
Go beyond the classroom and see how civil engineering projects come together. You’ll contribute to drawings and documentation used throughout projects from concept and design through to delivery.
Learn from experienced people
Ask questions, share ideas and learn from people who genuinely want to help you develop. You’ll receive guidance and mentoring as your skills and confidence grow.
Be part of a great team
Join a close-knit, collaborative team where people support each other, work together and enjoy what they do.
Work in Fortitude Valley
Our Brisbane office is in the heart of Fortitude Valley, close to public transport, cafés, restaurants and everything the city has to offer.
The Opportunity 
As you develop your skills, you’ll have the opportunity to:
- Assist with preparing civil drawings, plans and project documentation.
- Work with engineers and experienced drafters to produce clear, accurate and high-quality drawings.
- Learn industry standards, guidelines and best-practice drafting processes.
- Develop your understanding of how civil engineering projects are designed and delivered.
- Participate in project discussions and meetings to build your understanding of project requirements.
- Carry out basic drawing and documentation checks with guidance from experienced team members.
- Take on more responsibility as your skills and confidence develop.
About you:
You could be a great fit if you are:
- A Year 12 student, recent school leaver or currently studying Civil Drafting at TAFE.
- Genuinely interested in civil drafting, design and engineering.
- Curious and keen to learn new skills.
- Detail-oriented and take pride in producing accurate work.
- A good communicator who is comfortable asking questions and taking feedback.
- Reliable, organized and willing to have a go at new challenges.
- Someone who enjoys working with others and being part of a team.
- An Australian Citizen or Permanent Resident.
Most importantly, bring your enthusiasm and willingness to learn. We’ll help you turn it into a career.
What’s in it for you?
- 
Career development: Build your skills through hands-on experience, mentoring and ongoing professional development.
- 
Flexibility: Enjoy a 9-day fortnight, flexible working hours and the option to purchase additional leave.
- 
Competitive remuneration: A package that reflects your experience and contribution.
- 
Recognition and rewards: Employee referral rewards and recognition programs.
- 
Great culture: Work with supportive people in a friendly, collaborative environment, with regular team and social events.
- 
Wellbeing support: Access to a confidential Employee Assistance Program.
- 
Long-term opportunity: Build your career with an established, Australian-owned engineering consultancy.
About STP Consultants 
For more than 20 years, STP Consultants has been helping shape communities across Queensland. We’re a privately owned, multidisciplinary engineering consultancy, bringing together expertise across Civil, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical, Hydraulic, Fire and Seismic engineering. 
Our teams work on a diverse range of projects across Queensland, giving you the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals and see the many different paths an engineering career can take.
Our values of Potential, Respect, Integrity, Deliver and Engage shape the way we work with our clients and with each other.
We’re proud of our approachable leaders, supportive team environment and commitment to developing people and delivering quality engineering outcomes.
Ready to get started?  
If you’re looking for more than just a first job and want to build a career in engineering, we’d love to hear from you.
Click Apply and send us your Resume and Cover Letter.
In your cover letter, tell us:
1. Why you’re interested in starting a career in civil drafting.  2. What interests you about joining STP Consultants.
STP Consultants is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and welcome applications from all backgrounds.

candidates.content_text:
About Us
Launched in 2003, Cosmo Cranes is an Australian family owned & operated group that has earned a strong reputation as a leader of a reliable and modern crane fleet.
The group is made up of 5 divisions that all work in conjunction to provide a comprehensive range of materials handling solutions across a range of industrial, multi-story & high-rise construction projects.
The Role
An opportunity has become available for a Junior Draftsman. You will need great organisational & communication skills, be able to adapt to changes quickly, work well under pressure and help to maintain & continue to build upon the excellence of our team.
Key Requirements
-  Have Experience in AutoCAD
- Should have good familiarity with common AutoCAD commands. 
- Can work in model space & paper space.
- Can scale & import objects.
- Can use & modify blocks (& dynamic blocks – better).
- Familiarity of 3D Cartesian Space
- Cosmo draw 99% in 2D, but the candidate must understand how drawn items relate to the 3D world around it. 
- Current technical & engineering literacy
- Have a general understanding of how cranes move or work.
- Have a general understanding of building construction & engineering.
- Ability to learn new drafting concepts & techniques that may be unorthodox.
- The short term goal is to assimilate oneself to the current Cosmo drafting model.
Skills & Attributes
- Ability to work under pressure.
- Can work on multiple projects at any given time.
- Should have good time management & meet KPIs. 
- Self-motivated.
- Should have a strong passion & drive for the job.
- Self Confidence.
- Ability to show initiative. 
- Excellent communication skills – written & verbal
Full training will be provided along with support from the Drafting Team for the right candidate.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Trainee Structural Drafter to join our growing Structural & Civil team. Working alongside professional and experienced drafters and engineers on exciting, real-world projects, you will be provided with extensive hands on training to become highly skilled in Revit and other cutting edge BIM software. You will learn to produce accurate 2D drawings and complex 3D digital models, while collaborating closely with engineers and other design disciplines to coordinate project delivery. If you have a strong attention to detail, a passion for technology, and an eager desire to learn, this is the perfect opportunity to build a rewarding career from the ground up.
About JHA
JHA is a multi-disciplinary consultancy with a cutting-edge approach, committed to excellence in building services design, Structural & Civil Engineering and client service. From concept through to completion, JHA provides the best solutions for our clients across a wide portfolio of projects including aged care, commercial, community, education, government, health, hospitality, residential, retail and transportation.
Our Structural division is part of a business built on 30 years of excellence and continues to rapidly expand with a strong reputation for delivering innovative solutions across diverse sectors. We foster a culture of collaboration, mentoring and strong leadership, with a genuine investment in developing our people, from graduates and trainees through to senior engineers.
The Candidate
If you have recently completed your School Certificate or HSC, or you have started a drafting course at TAFE/MEGT or relevant organisation and have an interest in pursuing a career in drafting, your future could be at JHA. You will have access to a range of opportunities within JHA, and with our support, we will help you develop your career.
As the successful candidate you will possess:
•         The ability to work independently or collaboratively as part of a team.
•         Enthusiasm along with a passion for the construction and engineering industry.
•         Strong written and verbal communication skills.
•         A strong learning aptitude with an eagerness to master complex digital tools.
To apply for this role, please submit a resume and a brief cover letter to hr@jhaengineers.com.au.
